title: Monkey Tail Cactus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Trailing Cactus
description:
Grow your own captivating cascading cactus!


KEY FEATURES
• Unique cascading stems covered in soft, white, hair-like spines.
• Produces vibrant red flowers from late spring to early autumn.
• Ideal for hanging baskets, creating a spectacular 'living curtain'.
• Easy to grow and propagate, perfect for all skill levels.
• Adds an exotic and captivating touch to any plant collection.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Cacti & Succulents — Cleistocactus winteri subsp. colademononis
Colour: Bright red flowers, light green stems with white spines
Season: Late spring through early autumn (flowering)
Growth Habit: Trailing/Cascading


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, indirect light to partial sun (morning direct sun is ideal)
Soil: Well-draining, slightly acidic cactus/succulent potting mix (pH 5.5-6.5)
Watering: Water moderately during growing season (spring-summer), allowing soil to dry completely between waterings. Keep very dry in winter.
Spacing: Allow ample room for cascading stems, especially in hanging baskets.
Height: Stems can reach up to 8.2 feet (2.5 m) long
Spread: Stems can grow up to 3 inches (7 cm) wide
Hardiness: USDA zones 9a-11b (can tolerate short periods down to 21°F / -6°C if very dry)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Provide bright, indirect light; protect from intense midday sun to prevent sunscald.
• Use a well-draining cactus mix, amending with perlite or coarse sand for optimal drainage.
• Water thoroughly only when the soil has completely dried out, reducing frequency significantly in autumn and winter.
• Feed occasionally during the active growing season (spring-summer) with a high-potassium liquid cactus fertiliser.
• Repot every 2-3 years into a slightly larger pot with fresh soil to accommodate its rapid growth.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
